summary: Intrinsic ringed-site Higgs/constant-parameter connection continuation, preserving the twelve affine test nodes. The reserved definition, graded extension, curvature, transport and coefficient/filtration algebra are supplied as plans with explicit supplier boundaries. H.0 remains partial while supplier interfaces and full source decomposition remain open; H.1–H.8 stay unread. Eight coordinate determinant/gauge declarations add trace coefficients, trace curvature, flatness, dual/tensor compatibility and gauge-curvature invariance. The global exterior-power and determinant-line descent bridge remains explicit. Five further affine declaration plans decompose determinant differentiation, the trace row-action identity, coefficient/frame gauge compatibility, and determinant evaluation of the induced alternating operator. Global exterior-power/descent and all later-stage obligations remain open; The determinant adapters still have admitted native bodies. The generic matrix-unit Jacobi identity is imported once from ColemanPowerSeries:L1/derivation-determinant-unit. Ten action/ordered-nilpotence nodes import the built augmentation description, descend the symmetric action into the associative endomorphism algebra, identify exact augmentation-power annihilation and preserve the characteristic-two distinction between ordered and projected iterates. Global sheaf forms remain explicit omissions; spectral image algebras stay with the p-adic Simpson consumer. This continuation supplies actual bodies for fifteen existing affine declarations and ten native examples; the ordered-augmentation and global sheaf obligations remain open.

nodes.title: Commuting coordinate directions with constant parameter
nodes.statement: Frame consists of d k-linear derivations δ_i:R→R, pairwise commuting on every a∈R, with δ_i(λ)=0. This is a specified affine frame, not a definition of a general differential site.
hypotheses: k and R are commutative rings and R is a k-algebra.
d∈N and λ∈R; all derivations are k-linear.
proofSteps: Use the pinned Derivation carrier and record its pairwise commutation and constant-parameter equations.
Zero derivations give Frame.zero. On k[X_0,…,X_(d−1)], partial derivatives give Frame.polynomial with constant parameter C(c).
Prove polynomial commutation on monomials: successive removal of i,j has the same coefficient in both orders, including i=j; extend by k-linearity. Constants differentiate to zero.
Frame.one keeps the directions and uses δ_i(1)=0. No invertibility of λ is assumed.
acceptance: λ=X_0 with δ_0=∂_0 is excluded over Q since δ_0λ=1.
Zero directions are allowed, but are not universal differential forms.

nodes.statement: Over k=F₂, take E=k[x,y]/(x²,y²), Q=kq₀⊕kq₁, and θ(e)=xe⊗q₀+ye⊗q₁.
